# Sections

* [construction/](construction/) - How competition leotards are actually made: production order, negative ease, stretch direction, the three ways to realise a design line, seams, edges, lining, back and strap formulas, manufacturability rules, grading, and what a factory must receive.
* [embellishments/](embellishments/) - Crystals, spangles, pearls, nailheads and appliqué on competition leotards: what they are, sizes, grades, colours, how they are applied, where they may go, how designers lay them out, and what they cost.
* [fabrics/](fabrics/) - Leotard fabric families, how they are built (base cloth plus surface finish), stretch, sublimation, layering, the makers' combination rules, catalogues, prices and known data gaps.
* [garment/](garment/) - The named choices brands use to describe a leotard (garment type, sleeve, neckline, illusion layer, back, closure, straps, leg cut, fabric zones), how common each option is, how choices constrain each other, and what designers say makes a leotard work.
* [mannequins/](mannequins/) - Physical bodies used to show and fit leotards: retail display mannequins (finish, head, pose, stands, proportions), torso dress forms, child/teen/adult form measurements, freely licensed 3D references, and why our mannequins use real-body proportions.
* [market/](market/) - Leotard brands, price bands, the design studios and fashion software that exist today, how custom orders are placed, and the evidence for an unoccupied gap.
* [moodboard/](moodboard/) - The owner's 138-photo moodboard of real leotards, torn down image by image, and the design-space taxonomy synthesised from it; the acceptance set for the designer tool.
* [rules/](rules/) - FIG, USA Gymnastics (Development/Xcel) and NCAA attire rules as checkable design rules, plus national differences, rule conflicts, which limits are anatomical-geometric, and what could not be verified. Rule-checking features are deferred (owner decision 2026-10-13); the knowledge is kept for later.
* [sizing/](sizing/) - Leotard size ranges and charts (GK/Nike, Sylvia P, Quatro, Snowflake, Destira), the torso loop as the key measurement, long/short torso and fabric-specific sizing sets, body measurement targets by age, how a leotard sits on the body, stretch and negative ease, and the open question of grading designs across sizes.
